patch_list: Disable ads
Blocks ad insertion (incl. chat feed sponsored rows), Blizzard analytics uploads and removes the advertising ID permissions.
Disable location
Removes location permissions and reports no usable location provider.
Hide My AI
Hides the My AI row from the Chat list.
Hide Team Snapchat
Hides the Team Snapchat row from the Chat list.
Remove Games tab
Shows the plain Camera icon and label in the center tab instead of Games.
Remove Map tab
Removes the Map tab from the tab bar.
Remove Spotlight tab
Removes the Spotlight tab from the tab bar.
Remove Stories tab
Removes the Stories tab from the tab bar.
Show disclaimer
Shows a one-time warning before the login screen: Snapchat has historically been unfriendly to modified apps, so only use accounts you do not care about.
Spoof Snapchat signature
Required for login: reports Snapchat's original public certificate to in-process readers.
